== Possibly faulty data ==
* The Series 7 pack contents changed: the checklist first listed Rey, All Of The Jedi (AI), and a 3 March 2025 post by Gergall says the pack contains Outrider (V) (AI) instead. GEMP's code matches the corrected list. Rey, All Of The Jedi (AI) therefore appears under ''Other virtual Alternate Images''.
* The first (Series 1) paragraph follows the checklist's own wording. The checklist counts Jakku (Light Side) as a bonus 2018 OCS AI; GEMP lists it among Series 1's 22 cards.
* Forum post times use the forum's own (unstated) time zone, so only dates are given.
* After October 2022 the public GEMP repository is a bot mirror, so commit authors there are the sync bot, not the real contributors.

== Build notes ==
* The Series 1–8 groupings come from GEMP's <code>VirtualAlternateImageBoosterPack.java</code> (fixed card-id lists per series). Card counts agree with the Players Committee checklist for all eight series (22, 19, 15, 18, 18, 18, 16, 19). The Players Committee's Official Alternate Images PDF groups by exclusive year and public year instead, so it cannot be used to check the series.
* Series history in the public GEMP repository: Series 1 first appears in "Virtual Set 15 Merge From Main" (3 July 2021); Series 2 split out in the Set 16 update (4 September 2021).
* The checklist thread is https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=78442 (started 25 June 2021 by Jnapolit31, still updated). Related forum threads: 75602 (per-AI V-slip checklist), 58106 (original checklist), 81789 (Bonanza).
* The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage pages show both sides. The Card template only holds one set of stats, so the back side's stats are in the Card Text section.
